summary: Join our Critical Path Method (CPM) course tailored for project managers. Gain essential skills to manage timelines and improve project efficiency.
lede: Critical Path Method (CPM) training helps project managers and schedule professionals build and analyse schedules from linked activities. You’ll practise breaking scope into a WBS, sequencing dependencies, calculating early and late dates and float, identifying critical and near-critical paths, updating progress and forecasts, and assessing recovery options.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who create, review, control, or communicate project schedules across engineering, construction, information technology, infrastructure, manufacturing, energy, and professional services. It supports foundation-to-intermediate development and does not require advanced scheduling software experience.
prerequisites: No programming is required. You should have practical exposure to project activities, milestones, or delivery coordination. Basic spreadsheet skills help with CPM calculations, but the course provides templates and guided examples. Advanced software configuration, resource-loaded scheduling, and probabilistic analysis remain at overview level.
